patthana3.5:1.1: saññojanaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no saññojano kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.5:2.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ,
patthana3.5:4.1: saññojanaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojano akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, saññojanaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no saññojano akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, saññojanaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojano akusalo ca no saññojano akusalo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā,
patthana3.5:5.1: hetuyā nava, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, avigate nava,
patthana3.5:6.1: na hetuyā tīṇi, na adhipatiyā nava, na vippayutte nava,
patthana3.5:8.1: saññojano akusalo dhammo saññojanassa akusalassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo,
patthana3.5:9.1: hetuyā tīṇi, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, avigate nava,
patthana3.5:10.1: na hetuyā nava, na ārammaṇe nava,
patthana3.5:13.1: (yathā kusalattike pañhāvārassa anulomaṃpi paccaniyaṃpi anulomapaccaniyaṃpi paccaniyānulomaṃpi gaṇitaṃ, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.)
patthana3.5:14.1: no saññojanaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no saññojano abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.5:15.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ,
patthana3.5:17.1: saññojaniyaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojaniyo kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.5:18.1: asaññojaniyaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca asaññojaniyo kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.5:20.1: (yathā cūlantaraduke lokiyalokuttaraduka gamanaṃ. evaṃ imaṃpi ñātabbaṃ. sahajātavāropi pañhāvāropi vitthāretabbā.)
patthana3.5:21.1: saññojaniyaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojaniyo akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.5:22.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ,
patthana3.5:24.1: saññojaniyaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojaniyo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.5:25.1: asaññojaniyaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca asaññojaniyo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, asaññojaniyaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojaniyo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, asaññojaniyaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojaniyo abyākato ca asaññojaniyo abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā.
patthana3.5:26.1: saññojaniyaṃ abyākatañca asaññojaniyaṃ abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojaniyo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.5:27.1: hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe dve, adhipatiyā pañca, avigate pañca,
patthana3.5:29.1: saññojaniyo abyākato dhammo saññojaniyassa abyākatassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo.
patthana3.5:30.1: asaññojaniyo abyākato dhammo asaññājaniyassa abyākatassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo, tīṇi.
patthana3.5:31.1: hetuyā cattāri, ārammaṇe tīṇi, adhipatiyā cattāri, avigate satta,
patthana3.5:32.1: saññojaniyo abyākato dhammo saññojaniyassa abyākatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. sahajātapaccayena paccayo, upanissayapaccayena paccayo, purejāta paccayena paccayo, pacchājātapaccayena paccayo, āhārapaccayena paccayo, indriyapaccayena paccayo,
patthana3.5:33.1: na hetuyā satta, na ārammaṇe satta,
patthana3.5:36.1: (yathā kusalattike pañhāvārassa anulomaṃpi paccaniyaṃpi anulomapaccaniyaṃpi paccaniyānulomaṃpi gaṇitaṃ, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.)
patthana3.5:37.1: saññojanavippayuttaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojanavippayutto kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.5:38.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ,
patthana3.5:40.1: saññojanasampayuttaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojanasampayutto akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.5:41.1: saññojanasampayuttaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojanasampayutto akusalo dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā,
patthana3.5:42.1: hetuyā tīṇi ārammaṇe pañca, adhipatiyā ekaṃ, avigate pañca.
patthana3.5:43.1: saññojanasampayuttaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojanasampayutto akusalo dhammo uppajjati na hetupaccayā, vicikicchāsahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato mohā,
patthana3.5:44.1: na hetuyā dve, na adhipatiyā pañca, na purejāte pañca, …pe… na kamme tīṇi …pe… na vippayutte pañca,
patthana3.5:45.1: saññojanasampayutto akusalo dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa akusalassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo,
patthana3.5:46.1: saññojanavippayutto akusalo dhammo saññojanavimpayuttassa akusalassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo,
patthana3.5:48.1: saññojana sampayutto akusalo dhammo saññojanasampayuttassa akusalassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo,
patthana3.5:49.1: adhipatiyā ekaṃ, anantare nava, …pe… sahajāte pañca, …pe… upanissaye nava, āsevane nava, kamme tīṇi, …pe… magge tīṇi, sampayutte pañca, atthiyā pañca.
patthana3.5:50.1: saññojanavippayuttaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojanavippayutto abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana3.5:51.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ.
patthana3.5:53.1: no ca saññojanaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojaniyo ceva no ca saññojano kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.5:54.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ,
patthana3.5:56.1: saññojanañceva saññojaniyañca akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojano ceva saññojaniyo ca akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā, tīṇi.
patthana3.5:57.1: hetuyā nava, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, avigate nava,
patthana3.5:58.1: na hetuyā tīṇi. na adhipatiyā nava, na purejāte nava, na pacchājāte nava, na āsevane nava, na kamme tīṇi, na vipāke nava, na vippayutte nava,
patthana3.5:60.1: saññojano ceva saññojaniyo ca akusalo dhammo saññojanassa ceva saññojaniyassa ca akusalassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo,
patthana3.5:61.1: hetuyā tīṇi, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, avigate nava,
patthana3.5:62.1: na hetuyā nava, na ārammaṇe nava, hetu paccayā na ārammaṇe tīṇi, na
patthana3.5:65.1: (yathā kusalattike pañhāvārassa anulomaṃpi paccaniyaṃpi anulomapaccaniyaṃpi paccaniyānulomaṃpi gaṇitaṃ, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.)
patthana3.5:66.1: saññojaniyañceva no ca saññojanaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojaniyo ceva no ca saññojano abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.5:67.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ.
patthana3.5:69.1: saññojanañceva saññojanasampayuttañca akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojano ceva saññojanasampayutto ca akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana3.5:70.1: saññojanampayuttañceva no ca saññojanaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojanasampayutto ceva no ca saññojano akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.5:72.1: hetuyā nava, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, avigate nava,
patthana3.5:73.1: na hetuyā tīṇi, na adhipatiyā nava, na purejāte nava, na pacchājāte nava, na āsevane nava, na kamme tīṇi, na vipāke nava, na vippayutte nava,
patthana3.5:75.1: saññojano ceva saññojanasampayutto ca akusalo dhammo saññojanassa ceva saññojanasampayuttassa ca akusalassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo,
patthana3.5:76.1: hetuyā tīṇi, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, avigate nava,
patthana3.5:77.1: na hetuyā nava, na ārammaṇe nava.
patthana3.5:80.1: (yathā kusalattike pañhāvārassa anulomaṃpi paccaniyaṃpi anulomapaccaniyaṃpi paccaniyānulomaṃpi gaṇitaṃ, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ)
patthana3.5:81.1: saññojanavippayuttaṃ saññojaniyaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojanavippayutto saññojaniyo kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.5:82.1: saññojanavippayuttaṃ asaññojaniyaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojanavippayutto asaññojaniyo kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.5:83.1: hetuyā dve. ārammaṇe dve, avigate dve,
patthana3.5:84.1: (yathā? cūlantaraduke lokiyalokuntaraduka sadisaṃ sahajātavāropi pañhāvāropi sabbattha vitthāretabbo.)
patthana3.5:85.1: saññojanavippayutto saññojaniyo akusalo dhammo saññojanavippayuttassa saññojaniyassa akusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo.
patthana3.5:87.1: saññojanavippayuttaṃ saññojaniyaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojanavippayutto saññojaniyo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.5:88.1: saññojanavippayuttaṃ asaññojaniyaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojanavippayutto asaññojaniyo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, saññojanavippayuttaṃ asaññojaniyaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojanavippayutto saññojaniyo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, saññojanavippayuttaṃ asaññojaniyaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojanavippayutto asaññojaniyo abyākato ca saññojanavippayutto asaññojaniyo abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā,
patthana3.5:89.1: saññojanavippayuttaṃ saññojaniyaṃ abyākatañca saññojanavippayuttaṃ asaññojaniyaṃ abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca saññojanavippayutto saññojaniyo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.5:90.1: hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe dve, adhipatiyā pañca, kamme pañca, vipāke pañca, avigate pañca,
patthana3.5:91.1: na hetuyā ekaṃ, na ārammaṇe tīṇi, na adhipatiyā dve, na purejāte cattāri, na pacchāte pañca, na āsevane pañca, na kamme ekaṃ, na vipāke ekaṃ, na vippayutte dve, no vigate tīṇi,
patthana3.5:93.1: saññojanavippayutto saññojaniyo abyākato dhammo saññojanavippayuttassa saññojaniyassa abyākatassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo.
patthana3.5:94.1: hetuyā cattāri, ārammaṇe tīṇi, adhipatiyā cattāri, anantare cattāri, avigate satta,
patthana3.5:95.1: na hetuyā satta, na ārammaṇe satta,
patthana3.5:98.1: (yathā kusalattike pañhāvārassa anulomaṃpi paccaniyaṃpi anulomapaccaniyaṃpi paccaniyānulomaṃpi gaṇitaṃ, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.)
